value.rationale: The result characterizes a natural exact decision in an idealized two-resource phenological setting: where to center one fixed-duration feeding window. It proves a sharp change from one to two optimal dates, unique parameter boundary, quartic critical regime, square-root splitting coefficient and duration-dependent erasure of two-optimum structure despite distinct resource peaks. This answers a meaningful structural modeling question, not a mere parameter substitution or tiny decimal improvement; no field validation or applied intervention is asserted.
